_comment: MCP tool configuration for GAIA benchmark experiments. Tools are implemented in mcp_tools_server.py (FastMCP) and mcp_client.py (DirectToolManager).

gaia-tools._description: Local MCP server providing: search_web, read_file, run_python, analyze_image, fetch_webpage. Implemented with FastMCP framework.

_tools.name: search_web
_tools.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo (ddgs package). Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.

_tools.name: read_file
_tools.description: Read and extract content from files: PDF (pdftotext/PyPDF2), Excel (openpyxl), CSV, DOCX, PPTX, ZIP, JSON, TXT, PY, MP3/WAV (manus-speech-to-text), images (OCR via pytesseract).

_tools.name: run_python
_tools.description: Execute Python code in a sandboxed subprocess. Available packages: numpy, pandas, openpyxl, matplotlib, scipy, sympy, etc.

_tools.name: analyze_image
_tools.description: Perform OCR on image files (PNG, JPG, etc.) using pytesseract. Returns image metadata and extracted text.

_tools.name: fetch_webpage
_tools.description: Fetch and extract text content from a URL using httpx + BeautifulSoup.

web-research._description: Optional: External MCP web research server for enhanced web search capabilities.
